verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI creative platform with an API and MCP integration, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Pika offering scheduled or recurring generation jobs or workflows. The API, MCP connector and multi-step apps are developer building blocks or one-off actions that a user would have to schedule externally, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
